context.notes: Task: T-20260102-170726-202ca449 - CRITICAL: Fix index-store inconsistency on index save failure

intent: CRITICAL: Fix index-store inconsistency on index save failure

achieved: CRITICAL: Fix index-store inconsistency on index save failure

what_worked:
## What worked
- Clear analysis of the bug: _dirty flag cleared even on save failure
- Minimal, focused fix: return bool from save methods, only clear dirty on success
- Good test coverage with 9 new tests for save failure scenarios

## What didn't work
- Initial test for permission error failed in containerized environment (root user)
- Had to switch to mock-based testing for IOError simulation

## Root cause
_atomic_write_json() silently swallowed IOError and _save_indexes() unconditionally
set _dirty = False
what_didnt_work: This prevented retry of failed saves and left index stale
would_do_differently:
## Would have helped
- The existing self-healing mechanism (_rebuild_indexes on lazy init) already provides
  eventual consistency on restart, but the fix enables in-session retry without restart
